          <h1 class="section-heading">MyoSuite Models</h1>
        </div>
        <div class="articles-list">
          <div class="article-category">
        <div class="u-mb-4">
          <p class="page-lede">
            MyoSuite is an open-source collection of MuJoCo-based musculoskeletal environments for
            hand and limb movement simulation, developed by MyoHub. UpstreamDrift integrates MyoSuite as
            an <strong>experimental</strong> physics engine (the legacy internal alias <code>myosim</code>
            resolves to <code>myosuite</code> in
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/src/engines/tiers.py" target="_blank" rel="noopener">engine tier policy<span class="sr-only">(opens in a new tab)</span></a>).
            This is not Campbell's standalone MyoSim half-sarcomere simulator.
          </p>
          <div class="site-card site-card--callout u-mb-4">
            <h2 class="u-mb-1">Authority Boundary</h2>
            <p>
              <strong>This establishes</strong> educational orientation to MyoSuite musculoskeletal
              environments and the UpstreamDrift experimental engine tier recorded in the
              <a href="programming/engines.html">Programming Companion engines catalog</a>.
            </p>
            <p>
              <strong>This does not establish</strong> verified in-vivo muscle-force reproduction,
              cross-subject activation optimality, or clinical validity for rehabilitation or sports
              performance.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

          <div id="available-models" class="category-section">
            <h2 class="category-title">UpstreamDrift Context</h2>
        <div class="article-list-item">
          <h3>MuJoCo Musculoskeletal Environments</h3>
          <p>Task libraries for dexterous manipulation and locomotion with tendon-driven actuation,
          used for integration spikes rather than default release-gate validation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-list-item">
          <h3>Experimental Tier</h3>
          <p>Install via <code>pip install -e &quot;.[dev,biomechanics]&quot;</code> and expect
          best-effort local validation only, as documented in UpstreamDrift
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/docs/engines/support_tiers.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">engine support tiers<span class="sr-only">(opens in a new tab)</span></a>.</p>
        </div>
